{{AnimePokémonInfobox| trainername=Satoshi| pokemonname=Charizard | jtrainername=サトシ | jpokemonname=リザードン | tmtrainername=Satoshi | tmpokemonname=Lizardon | image=[[File:Satoshi Charizard Zensho.png|220px]] | caption=Satoshi's Charizard | location=[[Professor Oak's Laboratory]] | gender=Unknown | ability=Unknown | type1=Fire | type2=Flying | media=manga | evolution=2 | epnum=PZ01 | numeps1=3 | numeps2=4 | firststagename=Charmander | secondstagename=Charmeleon | epname=Prologue: Pallet Town | firstevoep=PZ04 | firstevoname=Vermilion City | prevonum=004 | evo1num=005 | evo2num=006 | secondevoep=PZ08 | secondevoname=Cinnabar Island | current=[[Party|With Satoshi]] | va=no | }} '''Satoshi's Charizard''' is {{Zensho|Satoshi}}'s first Pokémon in [[Pokémon Zensho]]. He received it in [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]] after it saved him from a {{p|Pidgey}}. {{spoilers}} ==History== [[File:Satoshi Charmander Zensho.png|thumb|left|200px|As a Charmander]] Charizard first appeared as a Charmander while [[Professor Oak]] was about to give away the [[first partner Pokémon]] to Satoshi and {{Zensho|Shigeru}}. Charmander attacked a {{p|Pidgey}} when it was going to attack Satoshi. At the lab, Satoshi immediately chose Charmander as his first partner Pokémon. He tested out Charmander by battling Shigeru's {{p|Squirtle}} in which the {{type|Fire}} was able to defeat Squirtle despite the type-disadvantage. Charmander woke up Satoshi with its tail and Satoshi traveled with it all the way to [[Pewter City]]. Arriving at the Pewter Gym, Charmander challenged [[Brock's Onix]] where it showed some incredible speed by dodging some of Onix's attacks and managed to defeat Onix by striking it on its rocky spine. Charmander has a battle with [[Team Rocket]]'s {{p|Beedrill}} when they took over [[Miracle Cycle]]. It was able to easily defeat Beedrill which sent Team Rocket running. Satoshi and Charmander arrive in [[Cerulean Gym]] where Satoshi attempted to use it to battle [[Misty]] but Charmander refused to do so as it was afraid of the water since it would put out the flame on Charmander's tail. [[File:Satoshi Charmeleon Zensho.png|thumb|left|200px|As a Charmeleon]] [[File:Satoshi and Charizard Zensho.png|thumb|200px|Charizard and Satoshi]] Later, Charmander had a [[rematch]] with Shigeru's Squirtle on the [[S.S. Anne]] where once again, Charmander was able to defeat Squirtle. The battle caused Charmander to evolve into Charmeleon. Satoshi and Charmeleon head to the [[Vermilion Gym]] and battled [[Lt. Surge]]'s {{p|Electabuzz}}. Charmeleon struggled with dealing with Electabuzz at first but finally defeated it with a combination of tying it up with a barbed-wire fence and attacking it with an unidentified Fire-type move. Satoshi headed to [[Celadon City]] and sent out Charmeleon to battle [[Erika]]'s {{p|Vileplume}} in the Gym there. When Vileplume's {{m|Petal Dance}} blinded Charmeleon, it caused a piece of flames from Charmeleon to accidentally burn part of Erika's kimono. Charmeleon attempted to put out the fire by slashing the burned areas. The referee was going to declare Erika as the winner since she saw Charmeleon attacking Erika, but Erika rewarded Satoshi the {{badge|Rainbow}} as Satoshi raised Charmeleon to be very kind. Later, Charmeleon battled with [[Blaine]]'s {{p|Arcanine}}. After defeating Arcanine, Charmeleon evolved into Charizard. Blaine borrowed it while he and Satoshi attempt to capture an {{p|Articuno}} at Seafoam Islands. With Satoshi's help and Charizard's method of flight, Blaine was able to get close enough to Articuno and catch it. Satoshi flies back home on Charizard and then flew to [[Viridian Gym]] to face the final Gym Leader. During the Gym battle against [[Giovanni]], Charizard was substituted for {{p|Lapras}} after Lapras got hit by {{p|Rhydon}}. When Charizard dealt damage to Rhydon, it caused Giovanni to explain to Satoshi about his character and rewarded Satoshi the {{badge|Earth}}. While flying back home, Satoshi and Charizard get attacked by Shigeru and {{p|Pidgeot}}. Since Charizard just finished the battle with Giovanni, Pidgeot sent it flying straight down. Back home, Charizard once again woke up Satoshi using the same technique when it was a Charmander. They fly away to [[Indigo Plateau]] to challenge the [[Elite Four]]. Charizard battled [[Lance's Dragonite]] where it was able to defeat Dragonite with an unidentified Fire-type move. It then battled with Shigeru's {{p|Blastoise}} and won, earning Satoshi the title as Champion. Sometime after Charizard dodged Blastoise's unidentified Water-type move, it hit one of the pillars and Satoshi pushed Shigeru out of the way to prevent him from getting crushed. ==Personality and characteristics== Charizard was shown to have cared for its Trainer, Satoshi, as seen in its debut chapter when it saved Satoshi from a {{p|Pidgey}}, which made Satoshi in return choose Charmander. Charmander has used many techniques which are considered extraordinary.
